# Track 1: Computer Science Bachelor Track

This track is intended for students who enter the RSE Master with a **Bachelor in Computer
Science**. Because the computer-science foundations are already covered by the entry degree, the
corresponding modules carry **0 ECTS** here; the freed-up capacity is invested into elective
computer-science depth, software engineering, a domain specialization, and the RSE-specific
competencies.

The curriculum follows the six competency areas (*Bereiche*) of Table 5.1 of the curricular
recommendations. The table below reproduces that structure with the ECTS that apply to Track 1.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

## Curriculum Structure (Track 1)

| Area / Module | ECTS |
|---|---:|
| **Computer Science** | **18** |
| [Foundations of Computer Science](../modules/gen_cs.qmd) | 0 |
| [Foundations of Software Development](../modules/gen_softwareeng1.qmd) | 0 |
| [Algorithms and Data Structures](../modules/gen_programming.qmd) | 0 |
| [Computer Science Elective](../modules/cs_elective.qmd) | 18 *** |
| **Software Engineering** | **18** |
| [Requirements Engineering](../modules/standard.qmd) | 6 *** |
| [Software Architecture](../modules/standard.qmd) | 6 *** |
| [Software Testing](../modules/standard.qmd) | 6 *** |
| **Domain Specializations** | **12** |
| [Domain Specialization Electives (foreign domain)](../modules/mnt_wildcard.qmd) | 12 |
| [Computational Research in the Domain](../modules/mnt_compwildcard.qmd) | 0 |
| **Technical Competencies for RSEs** | **15** |
| [Applied Software Development Tools and Techniques](../modules/rse_nuts_bolts.qmd) | 3 |
| [Introduction to Scientific Computing](../modules/rse_scientificcomputing.qmd) | 0 ** |
| [Machine Learning](../modules/standard.qmd) | 6 |
| [Software Development for RSEs](../modules/rse_softwareengineering.qmd) | 6 |
| **Social Competencies for RSEs** | **9** |
| [RSEng Management](../modules/rse_management.qmd) | 6 |
| [RSEng, Ethics & Society](../modules/rse_society_philosophy.qmd) | 0 |
| [RSEng Teaching](../modules/rse_teaching.qmd) | 3 |

| [RSEng Lecture Series](../modules/rse_lectureseries.qmd) | 3 |
| [Research Paradigms and Methodology for RSEs](../modules/rse_researchmethods.qmd) | 3 |
| [RSEng Project](../modules/cs_project.qmd) | 12 |
| [Master's Thesis](../modules/rse_thesis.qmd) | 30 |
| **Total** | **120** |

: Modules and ECTS for Track 1 {tbl-colwidths="[80,20]"}

*A value of 0 ECTS means the competency is already provided by the Computer Science entry Bachelor
and is listed only for completeness.*

**\*\*** Recommended for Track 1 students interested in natural-science RSE as an alternative to the
elective Software Engineering courses.

**\*\*\*** Recommended courses for the elective area, subject to availability (see alternatives in
the text). The specific computer-science electives are listed on the
[Computer Science Elective](../modules/cs_elective.qmd) page.
